usage.callShape: POST https://api.strale.io/x402/web-extract with JSON body {url, extract}
usage.outputShape: body.data.main_content (extracted text), body.data.page_title, body.data.page_url; top-level body.page_title and body.source_url; payment meta at body.data._meta.payment
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with required "url" (the page to scrape) and optional "extract" (natural-language description of what data you want) to https://api.strale.io/x402/web-extract. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, settled synchronously; one call returned ~$0.162. Read the structured result from body.data (page_title, main_content, page_url, and optionally links/headings/paragraphs per the schema). It renders JavaScript so it works on dynamic pages.
